Document: "Waste-derived mesoporous biochar for glycerol to glycerol carbonate upgrading: intensified process design and techno-economic analysis"

The optimal conditions for glycerol carbonate synthesis were found to be:
- Catalyst loading: 3.45 wt%
- DMC:glycerol molar ratio: 3.58:1
- Reaction temperature: 90.20 °C
- Reaction time: 119 min

These conditions resulted in a predicted glycerol carbonate yield of 94.77%, which was near the actual obtained experimental yield of 92.40%.
